title: Preview
subtitle: Every page, its image beside the reflowed text: reading order, missing headers, notes, tables shown as original page, hyphenation, marked English terms.

forbidden.scope: Publish negotiation documents, or post correction notes on them, across the whole platform
forbidden.description: The preview of Guide Négo documents is reserved for the people who publish documents and for the experts who correct them. An account attached to a single event has no access to it.

error.title: The preview could not be loaded

notReady.title: No pages to browse yet
notReady.description: Extraction: {state}. The pages will appear here as soon as it is ready.
notReady.noFile: This document has no PDF file: there is nothing to extract. Upload it from the record.

asIs.label: Open as is
asIs.hint: The whole document reads as original pages, without text size, tappable terms or text search. This choice can be changed without republishing.
asIs.readOnly: Only a person who publishes documents can change this choice.
asIs.failed: The reading mode did not change

outline.title: Detected outline
outline.empty: No outline was detected in this document.

pager.label: Browse the pages
pager.keyboard: Use the ← → keys to turn pages.

image.title: Original page
image.alt: Image of page {label} of the document
image.offline: Page images only come from the API. The sample data does not serve any.
image.missing: The image of this page was not kept.
image.failed: The image of this page could not be loaded.

reading.title: Readable form
reading.empty: No text was extracted from this page.

origin.hint: Shown as original page in the reader.

notes.title: Correction notes
notes.subtitle: A note sits on top of the text without changing it. It appears in the app, downloaded copies included, at the next library refresh.
notes.error: The notes could not be loaded
notes.readOnly: Only experts post and withdraw notes. You see them here as the app shows them.
notes.elsewhereEmpty: No notes on the other pages.
notes.pageTop: Top of the page — no passage targeted

form.title: Post a note — page {index}, p. {label}
form.noPassage: Select a passage in the readable text above. Without a selection, the note goes at the top of the page.
form.clearPassage: Target the top of the page
form.bodyEnHint: Optional. Without it, the app shows the French text.
form.frRequired: The French text of the note is required.
form.posted: Note posted. It will appear in the app at the next library refresh.

confirm.title: Withdraw this note?
confirm.description: It will disappear from the app, downloaded copies included, at their next refresh. The note stays here, with who posted it, who withdrew it and when.
